cloudConnection.previousFailure: 401 after the old hidden input could truncate long credentials; historical diagnostic retained below.

persistentConnection.mechanism: Per-user low-priority launchd monitor invokes official managed runtimes connect. It never kills an existing live runtime. The user-operated repair flow can replace a rejected credential and restart only that dedicated runtime.

inputTruncationEvidence.conclusion: The old prompt can truncate long keys. This is a supported cause to repair, not proof the user's original full key is invalid.
inputTruncationEvidence.repair: Python termios-based getpass reads the full line, then Security.framework saves CFData directly without argv, files or interactive command history.
